text:
maya: CI red on master: //runtime:allocator_test failing intermittently on macOS-latest. Failing with 'heartbeat timeout' inside allocator loop. anyone seen this today?
ryan: saw one earlier this morning but chalked it up to CI flakiness. can you paste the failing log?
maya: pasted quick excerpt — it reproduces locally sometimes.
```
Run tests: runtime/allocator_test
[ RUN      ] Allocator.HeartbeatPreempt
E2026-03-15 09:12:34.123 allocator.cc:412] heartbeat timeout waiting for ack
E2026-03-15 09:12:34.123 allocator.cc:289] attempt=3 -> aborting test
[  FAILED  ] Allocator.HeartbeatPreempt (15 ms)
```
ryan: hmm looks like the heartbeat thread didn't get scheduled. could be timer granularity on mac agents or a race with test teardown. did you try rerunning?
maya: reran once (CI) and it passed. reran locally with `--runs_per_test=5` and hit fail on run 4.
sam: this smells like nondeterministic scheduling. two quick things: 1) try setting TEST_DETERMINISM=1 env to enable deterministic scheduler in dev build, 2) run with a fixed seed: `TEST_SEED=98765 bazel test //runtime:allocator_test --runs_per_test=50`
anya: can we bisect to find the commit that increased frequency? maya — what range to blame?
maya: last green was at 2468000123, first red seen at 2468099999. i'll bisect if we agree on the script.
ryan: i'll run a quick seed sweep on my mac-mini. command i use: `for s in 10000 10001 10002 10003; do TEST_SEED=$s bazel test //runtime:allocator_test --test_output=errors || break; done` — will capture failing seed.
maya: fyi when it failed locally i grabbed a tiny stack:
```
#0  0x7fff... in pthread_cond_timedwait
#1  runtime::Heartbeat::wait_ack (heartbeat.cc:78)
#2  runtime::Allocator::background_loop (allocator.cc:401)
#3  std::thread::start_thunk
```
sam: looks like the test expects the background loop ack within N ms; if scheduling is delayed the test aborts. two mitigation paths: a) make the test tolerate longer wait (increase timeout or poll), b) mock out the heartbeat timing in test to avoid real thread scheduling, c) special-case the mac CI agent by moving the test to flaky-tests job.
maya: leaning to (b) for correctness; but that'll take a PR. short-term (c) removes blocker.
anya: TODOs: maya open issue + PR to move test to flaky-tests job, sam to prototype mocking heartbeat, ryan to run seed sweep and post any failing seeds, dev-sre to pin current CI run so master doesn't block.
ryan: ran sweep, reproduced locally with TEST_SEED=10002. attaching log excerpt below.
```
[ RUN      ] Allocator.HeartbeatPreempt (seed=10002)
E allocator.cc: heartbeat timeout after 50ms
Stack: runtime::Heartbeat::wait_ack -> runtime::Allocator::background_loop -> test main
```
maya: thanks — i'll open GH issue and include the seed and logs. i'll also schedule a CI rerun with `--runs_per_test=20` and add an env var to the job: `PIN_TO_FLAKY_QUEUE=1` until we fix.
dev-bot: CI Summary: build 2468.123 failed, 1 failing test — //runtime:allocator_test. Re-run requested by maya.
dev-sre: okay to pin this to flaky job for now. please include label `flaky:allocator` on the issue. also add a short note to release notes so we don't lose context.
sam: for the PR, i'd avoid blindly increasing timeouts. i'll try to mock the heartbeat thread and add a deterministic hook so the test asserts the ack path without relying on OS scheduling. will send WIP later today.
anya: if sam's change lands we should remove the flaky tag and re-run the full CI. can someone volunteer to follow up on backporting to the maintenance branch if needed?
maya: i'll take ownership of follow-ups and the issue. will update thread when PRs exist. thanks all :eyes:
